conversations.title: Meet the Guide
conversations.description: Find your guide at the meeting point and check your ticket.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Siete qui per il tour del centro storico delle dieci?
messages.english: Good morning! Are you here for the ten o'clock tour of the historic center?

choices.text: Sì, buongiorno! Siamo qui per il tour delle dieci.
choices.english: Yes, good morning! We are here for the ten o'clock tour.
choices.feedback: Ottimo! Confirming the time and greeting the guide is perfect.

choices.text: A che ora chiude il museo archeologico stasera?
choices.english: What time does the archaeological museum close tonight?
choices.feedback: Focus on the current tour meeting first.

choices.text: Il tour inizia tra dieci minuti esatti, credo.
choices.english: The tour starts in exactly ten minutes, I believe.
choices.feedback: You should answer the guide's question first.

messages.text: Perfetto. Io sono Marco, la vostra guida. Avete il biglietto?
messages.english: Perfect. I am Marco, your guide. Do you have the ticket?

choices.text: Piacere Marco. Sì, ecco il mio biglietto sul telefono.
choices.english: Nice to meet you, Marco. Yes, here is my ticket on the phone.
choices.feedback: Excellent. Showing the ticket is the next logical step.

choices.text: No, purtroppo ho dimenticato il biglietto in hotel.
choices.english: No, unfortunately I forgot the ticket in the hotel.
choices.feedback: That's a problem! You need your ticket for the tour.

choices.text: Scusi, dove posso comprare il biglietto ora, per favore?
choices.english: Excuse me, where can I buy the ticket now, please?
choices.feedback: The guide is asking if you ALREADY have it.

messages.text: Grazie. Il gruppo è quasi pronto. Avete scarpe comode per camminare?
messages.english: Thank you. The group is almost ready. Do you have comfortable shoes for walking?

choices.text: Sì, ho le scarpe da ginnastica. Sono molto comode.
choices.english: Yes, I have sneakers. They are very comfortable.
choices.feedback: Good! Comfort is important for a walking tour.

choices.text: Quanto tempo cammineremo durante questo lungo tour?
choices.english: How long will we walk during this long tour?
choices.feedback: Answer the question about your shoes first.

choices.text: Dove sono tutti gli altri turisti di questo gruppo?
choices.english: Where are all the other tourists in this group?
choices.feedback: They are arriving, but focus on your equipment.

messages.text: Molto bene. Aspettiamo ancora due minuti e poi cominciamo la visita.
messages.english: Very well. We wait two more minutes and then we start the visit.

choices.text: Va bene, aspettiamo qui vicino alla fontana.
choices.english: Alright, we wait here near the fountain.
choices.feedback: Perfect. Staying near the meeting point is smart.

choices.text: Vado a comprare una bottiglia d'acqua fresca ora.
choices.english: I'm going to buy a bottle of fresh water now.
choices.feedback: Don't leave now, you might miss the start!

choices.text: Il mio gruppo è già partito senza di me, purtroppo.
choices.english: My group has already left without me, unfortunately.
choices.feedback: No, the guide just said you are starting in two minutes.

messages.text: Ecco il resto del gruppo. Siete pronti per iniziare questa avventura?
messages.english: Here is the rest of the group. Are you ready to start this adventure?

choices.text: Sì, siamo prontissimi! Andiamo.
choices.english: Yes, we are very ready! Let's go.
choices.feedback: Great enthusiasm! Let's go.

choices.text: No, preferisco aspettare qui fuori da solo.
choices.english: No, I prefer to wait here outside by myself.
choices.feedback: You'll miss the tour! It's starting now.

choices.text: Quanto costa l'ingresso alla chiesa grande?
choices.english: How much is the entrance to the big church?
choices.feedback: The guide will tell you later, now just say if you're ready.

messages.text: Ottimo. Siete un gruppo molto puntuale. Avete bisogno di una mappa?
messages.english: Great. You are a very punctual group. Do you need a map?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Una mappa è sempre utile.
choices.english: Yes, thanks. A map is always useful.
choices.feedback: Helpful to have a physical map sometimes.

choices.text: No, preferisco usare il mio telefono nuovo.
choices.english: No, I prefer to use my new phone.
choices.feedback: Digital maps work too, but the guide is offering one.

choices.text: Dove posso trovare un ufficio postale qui?
choices.english: Where can I find a post office here?
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the start of the tour.

messages.text: Certamente, ecco a voi. Prima di iniziare, avete altre domande?
messages.english: Certainly, here you go. Before we start, do you have other questions?

choices.text: Sì, quanto tempo dura l'intero tour oggi?
choices.english: Yes, how long does the whole tour last today?
choices.feedback: Good to know the schedule.

choices.text: No, non ho assolutamente nessuna domanda ora.
choices.english: No, I have absolutely no questions now.
choices.feedback: Valid, but the correct answer is more engaging.

choices.text: Il bagno è vicino a questa piazza antica?
choices.english: Is the bathroom near this ancient square?
choices.feedback: Maybe ask later or before the start.

messages.text: Dura circa due ore. Faremo diverse soste interessanti. Va bene?
messages.english: It lasts about two hours. We will make several interesting stops. Is that okay?

choices.text: Sì, va bene. Due ore sono perfette.
choices.english: Yes, it's fine. Two hours are perfect.
choices.feedback: Confirming the schedule is good.

choices.text: Due ore sono troppe per camminare così.
choices.english: Two hours are too many to walk like this.
choices.feedback: A bit negative! Walking tours require some stamina.

choices.text: Vorrei un caffè prima di camminare tanto.
choices.english: I would like a coffee before walking so much.
choices.feedback: No time for coffee now!

messages.text: Benissimo. Allora mettiamoci in cammino. Seguitemi, per favore.
messages.english: Very well. Then let's get moving. Follow me, please.

choices.text: D'accordo, la seguiamo con molta attenzione.
choices.english: Agreed, we follow you very carefully.
choices.feedback: Showing readiness to follow instructions.

choices.text: Aspetti, devo allacciare bene le scarpe.
choices.english: Wait, I have to tie my shoes well.
choices.feedback: Be quick! The group is moving.

choices.text: Posso correre davanti a tutto il gruppo?
choices.english: Can I run in front of the whole group?
choices.feedback: No, stay with the guide.

messages.text: Spero che questa passeggiata vi piaccia. Cominciamo dal duomo!
messages.english: I hope you enjoy this walk. Let's start with the cathedral!

choices.text: Sì, sono curioso di vedere il duomo.
choices.english: Yes, I am curious to see the cathedral.
choices.feedback: Great start to the tour.

choices.text: Il duomo è troppo lontano da qui ora.
choices.english: The cathedral is too far from here now.
choices.feedback: The guide knows the way!

choices.text: Preferisco vedere il mercato della frutta.
choices.english: I prefer to see the fruit market.
choices.feedback: The tour has a set itinerary.

conversations.title: Walking Instructions
conversations.description: Follow the guide's instructions and stay with the group.

messages.text: Attenzione, per favore! Camminiamo insieme e restiamo vicini.
messages.english: Attention, please! Let's walk together and stay close.

choices.text: D'accordo. Dobbiamo seguire la sua bandierina?
choices.english: Agreed. Do we have to follow your flag?
choices.feedback: Good question. Guides often use flags to stay visible.

choices.text: Dobbiamo camminare molto velocemente ora?
choices.english: Do we have to walk very fast now?
choices.feedback: The guide didn't say that, just to stay close.

choices.text: Dov'è la nostra prossima tappa del tour?
choices.english: Where is our next stop of the tour?
choices.feedback: Wait for the guide to lead you there.

messages.text: Sì, seguite sempre la mia bandierina blu. Ora giriamo a destra in questo vicolo.
messages.english: Yes, always follow my blue flag. Now we turn right into this alley.

choices.text: Ho capito, giriamo a destra. Questo vicolo è molto stretto!
choices.english: I understand, we turn right. This alley is very narrow!
choices.feedback: Good observation. Italian alleys can be very narrow.

choices.text: Scusi, possiamo fermarci un momento qui, per favore?
choices.english: Excuse me, can we stop for a moment here, please?
choices.feedback: Better to keep moving with the group for now.

choices.text: Mi serve una mappa della città subito, Marco.
choices.english: I need a map of the city right now, Marco.
choices.feedback: You have a guide! You don't need a map right now.

messages.text: Fate attenzione ai gradini, sono antichi e un po' scivolosi.
messages.english: Pay attention to the steps, they are ancient and a bit slippery.

choices.text: Grazie dell'avviso. Camminerò con molta attenzione.
choices.english: Thanks for the warning. I will walk very carefully.
choices.feedback: Safety first! Good response.

choices.text: C'è un ascensore per salire in alto qui vicino?
choices.english: Is there an elevator to go up high near here?
choices.feedback: Unlikely in this ancient alley!

choices.text: Chi ha costruito questo palazzo antico così grande?
choices.english: Who built this ancient palace so large?
choices.feedback: The guide is warning you about the steps right now.

messages.text: Adesso ci fermiamo in questa piazza. Ascoltate bene la spiegazione.
messages.english: Now we stop in this square. Listen carefully to the explanation.

choices.text: Va bene, mi fermo qui. Sono pronto ad ascoltare.
choices.english: Alright, I stop here. I am ready to listen.
choices.feedback: Perfect. Listening is the main part of the tour.

choices.text: Posso scattare delle foto ora in questa piazza?
choices.english: Can I take some photos now in this square?
choices.feedback: Wait a moment and listen to the explanation first.

choices.text: La guida parla troppo velocemente per me oggi.
choices.english: The guide speaks too fast for me today.
choices.feedback: Try to focus, or ask politely later.

messages.text: Se qualcuno si perde, ci incontriamo davanti alla chiesa grande. Chiaro?
messages.english: If someone gets lost, we meet in front of the big church. Clear?

choices.text: Sì, tutto chiaro. Ci vediamo davanti alla chiesa.
choices.english: Yes, all clear. See you in front of the church.
choices.feedback: Good. Confirming the emergency meeting point.

choices.text: Dov'è il punto di incontro finale del tour oggi?
choices.english: Where is the final meeting point of the tour today?
choices.feedback: The guide is talking about the emergency meeting point now.

choices.text: C'è un bagno pubblico qui vicino alla chiesa?
choices.english: Is there a public bathroom near the church here?
choices.feedback: Not the time to ask about bathrooms.

messages.text: Perfetto. Ora dobbiamo attraversare la strada. Fate attenzione!
messages.english: Perfect. Now we have to cross the street. Be careful!

choices.text: Va bene. Dobbiamo usare le strisce pedonali?
choices.english: Alright. Do we have to use the crosswalk?
choices.feedback: Safety first!

choices.text: Posso correre velocemente dall'altra parte ora?
choices.english: Can I run quickly to the other side now?
choices.feedback: No, wait for the guide and the group.

choices.text: Quanto traffico c'è in questa città moderna!
choices.english: How much traffic there is in this modern city!
choices.feedback: True, but focus on crossing safely.

messages.text: Sì, restate sulle strisce e seguite il mio segnale.
messages.english: Yes, stay on the crosswalk and follow my signal.

choices.text: Ho capito. Siamo tutti pronti ad attraversare.
choices.english: I understand. We are all ready to cross.
choices.feedback: Good to confirm for the group.

choices.text: Il semaforo è ancora rosso per i pedoni.
choices.english: The traffic light is still red for pedestrians.
choices.feedback: Wait for it to turn green!

choices.text: Mi piacciono molto queste macchine italiane.
choices.english: I like these Italian cars very much.
choices.feedback: Stay focused on crossing.

messages.text: Molto bene. Ora entriamo in questa zona pedonale più tranquilla.
messages.english: Very well. Now we enter this quieter pedestrian area.

choices.text: Meno male! Qui si cammina molto meglio.
choices.english: Thank goodness! It's much better to walk here.
choices.feedback: Pedestrian areas are much nicer for tours.

choices.text: Ci sono molti negozi interessanti in questa via.
choices.english: There are many interesting shops in this street.
choices.feedback: Don't get distracted by shopping yet!

choices.text: A che ora finisce questa parte del tour?
choices.english: What time does this part of the tour end?
choices.feedback: Just enjoy the walk.

messages.text: Infatti. Guardate queste finestre fiorite, sono tipiche.
messages.english: Indeed. Look at these flowered windows, they are typical.

choices.text: Sono bellissime! Posso scattare una foto veloce?
choices.english: They are beautiful! Can I take a quick photo?
choices.feedback: Perfectly fine in a pedestrian area.

choices.text: Che tipo di fiori sono quelli nelle finestre?
choices.english: What kind of flowers are those in the windows?
choices.feedback: A bit too specific for the guide, maybe.

choices.text: Le finestre di casa mia sono molto diverse.
choices.english: The windows of my house are very different.
choices.feedback: Not very relevant.

messages.text: Certo, ma fate presto. Dobbiamo raggiungere la prossima piazza.
messages.english: Sure, but be quick. We need to reach the next square.

choices.text: Sì, ho fatto. Sono pronto a continuare.
choices.english: Yes, I'm done. I'm ready to continue.
choices.feedback: Good, keeping up with the group is important.

choices.text: Voglio fare altre dieci foto a quel balcone.
choices.english: I want to take ten more photos of that balcony.
choices.feedback: Too many! The group is leaving.

choices.text: Mi sono perso, non vedo più la bandierina.
choices.english: I'm lost, I don't see the flag anymore.
choices.feedback: The guide is right in front of you!

conversations.title: Historical Facts
conversations.description: Ask the guide about a monument and learn some history.

messages.text: Questo palazzo è del quindicesimo secolo. Era la casa di una famiglia famosa.
messages.english: This palace is from the fifteenth century. It was the home of a famous family.

choices.text: Che bello! Come si chiamava questa famiglia?
choices.english: How nice! What was the name of this family?
choices.feedback: Good question! Showing interest in the history.

choices.text: Questo palazzo è molto moderno, credo.
choices.english: This palace is very modern, I believe.
choices.feedback: No, the guide said it's from the 15th century!

choices.text: Vorrei comprare un souvenir tipico qui.
choices.english: I would like to buy a typical souvenir here.
choices.feedback: This is a historical palace, not a shop.

messages.text: Si chiamava la famiglia Medici. Erano molto potenti a quel tempo.
messages.english: It was called the Medici family. They were very powerful at that time.

choices.text: Interessante. Perché erano così famosi?
choices.english: Interesting. Why were they so famous?
choices.feedback: Following up with a 'why' question is great for learning.

choices.text: Non conosco affatto questa famiglia famosa.
choices.english: I don't know this famous family at all.
choices.feedback: That's why the guide is telling you about them!

choices.text: Il tempo oggi è molto bello per camminare.
choices.english: The weather today is very nice for walking.
choices.feedback: Stay on topic: the Medici family.

messages.text: Erano banchieri e amavano molto l'arte. Hanno aiutato molti artisti.
messages.english: They were bankers and loved art very much. They helped many artists.

choices.text: Ah, ecco perché ci sono così tante sculture qui!
choices.english: Ah, that's why there are so many sculptures here!
choices.feedback: Making the connection between the facts and what you see.

choices.text: Dove posso cambiare i miei soldi stasera?
choices.english: Where can I change my money tonight?
choices.feedback: The guide mentioned bankers, but in a historical context.

choices.text: Mi piace molto dipingere quadri nel tempo libero.
choices.english: I like painting pictures very much in my free time.
choices.feedback: A bit off-topic. Focus on the Medici.

messages.text: Esatto. Guardate questa scultura sopra l'ingresso. È un capolavoro.
messages.english: Exactly. Look at this sculpture above the entrance. It's a masterpiece.

choices.text: È veramente bellissima. Di quale artista è?
choices.english: It is truly beautiful. Which artist is it by?
choices.feedback: Asking for the artist is a perfect follow-up.

choices.text: Quanto costa questa scultura antica di marmo?
choices.english: How much does this ancient marble sculpture cost?
choices.feedback: It's part of the building, it's not for sale.

choices.text: Non mi piacciono le statue di marmo bianco.
choices.english: I don't like white marble statues.
choices.feedback: Try to appreciate the art during the tour.

messages.text: È di un giovane artista dell'epoca. Avete altre domande sulla storia?
messages.english: It is by a young artist of the time. Do you have other questions about history?

choices.text: Sì, vorrei sapere di più sulla chiesa che vediamo.
choices.english: Yes, I would like to know more about the church we see.
choices.feedback: Great! Moving the conversation to the next visible landmark.

choices.text: No, preferisco andare a mangiare qualcosa ora.
choices.english: No, I prefer to go eat something now.
choices.feedback: The tour isn't finished yet!

choices.text: Qual è la capitale della Francia, Marco?
choices.english: What is the capital of France, Marco?
choices.feedback: Out of domain! Stay in Italy and on the tour.

messages.text: Quella è la Cattedrale di Santa Maria. È stata costruita su un tempio romano.
messages.english: That is the Cathedral of Santa Maria. It was built on a Roman temple.

choices.text: Davvero? Quindi ci sono rovine romane sotto?
choices.english: Really? So there are Roman ruins underneath?
choices.feedback: Excellent deduction. You are engaging with the history.

choices.text: Mi serve un nuovo caricabatterie per il telefono.
choices.english: I need a new charger for the phone.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the cathedral's history.

choices.text: Il gatto è sul tavolo della cucina bianca.
choices.english: The cat is on the white kitchen table.
choices.feedback: Completely off-topic!

messages.text: Sì, esattamente. È possibile visitare i sotterranei con un biglietto speciale.
messages.english: Yes, exactly. It is possible to visit the underground with a special ticket.

choices.text: Che bella idea! Dove posso comprare i biglietti?
choices.english: What a nice idea! Where can I buy tickets?
choices.feedback: Practical and relevant question.

choices.text: Mi piace molto il gelato alla fragola fresca.
choices.english: I like fresh strawberry gelato very much.
choices.feedback: Wait until after the tour for gelato!

choices.text: Quanto costa spedire questo pacco postale ora?
choices.english: How much does it cost to send this postal package now?
choices.feedback: The guide is talking about tickets for the ruins.

messages.text: Potete trovarli all'ufficio turistico o direttamente all'ingresso della cattedrale.
messages.english: You can find them at the tourist office or directly at the entrance of the cathedral.

choices.text: Grazie. La cattedrale è aperta tutto il giorno?
choices.english: Thank you. Is the cathedral open all day?
choices.feedback: Good question about opening hours.

choices.text: La mia macchina è parcheggiata male fuori.
choices.english: My car is parked badly outside.
choices.feedback: Don't worry about that now, follow the tour.

choices.text: Cerco un paio di scarpe eleganti e nere.
choices.english: I am looking for a pair of elegant black shoes.
choices.feedback: You should have worn comfortable shoes for the tour!

messages.text: Sì, ma durante la messa non è possibile fare visite turistiche.
messages.english: Yes, but during mass it is not possible to take tourist visits.

choices.text: Capisco. A che ora c'è la prossima messa?
choices.english: I understand. What time is the next mass?
choices.feedback: Polite and shows consideration for local customs.

choices.text: Voglio vedere un film al cinema stasera.
choices.english: I want to see a movie at the cinema tonight.
choices.feedback: Not related to the cathedral's schedule.

choices.text: Il caffè è troppo amaro per i miei gusti.
choices.english: The coffee is too bitter for my taste.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant.

messages.text: C'è una messa alle diciotto. Volete continuare il nostro giro verso il fiume?
messages.english: There is a mass at six PM. Do you want to continue our tour towards the river?

choices.text: Sì, andiamo volentieri. La vista sarà bellissima!
choices.english: Yes, we gladly go. The view will be beautiful!
choices.feedback: Perfect response to continue the tour.

choices.text: Prendo un cornetto e un cappuccino caldo.
choices.english: I'll have a croissant and a hot cappuccino.
choices.feedback: It's not breakfast time!

choices.text: Il treno per Milano parte dal binario sei.
choices.english: The train for Milan leaves from platform six.
choices.feedback: You are not at the station.

messages.text: Ottimo. Il fiume Arno è molto vicino. Vedremo anche il ponte vecchio.
messages.english: Great. The Arno river is very close. We will also see the old bridge.

choices.text: Il ponte vecchio è famoso per i gioielli?
choices.english: Is the old bridge famous for jewelry?
choices.feedback: Excellent question about a famous landmark.

choices.text: Quanto costa un anello d'oro oggi in città?
choices.english: How much does a gold ring cost today in the city?
choices.feedback: Wait until you get to the shops!

choices.text: Mi piace molto nuotare nei fiumi freddi.
choices.english: I like swimming in cold rivers very much.
choices.feedback: Don't swim in the Arno!

messages.text: Sì, esattamente. Ci sono molte botteghe di orafi sopra il ponte.
messages.english: Yes, exactly. There are many goldsmith shops on the bridge.

choices.text: Incredibile! Non vedo l'ora di vederle.
choices.english: Incredible! I can't wait to see them.
choices.feedback: Enthusiasm is always good on a tour.

choices.text: Preferisco comprare un libro di storia ora.
choices.english: I prefer to buy a history book now.
choices.feedback: You can do that after the tour.

choices.text: Il mio orologio si è fermato stamattina.
choices.english: My watch stopped this morning.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant.

conversations.title: Taking Photos
conversations.description: Take a photo of the group and ask for a photo yourself.

messages.text: Siamo arrivati davanti alla fontana più bella. Volete fare delle foto?
messages.english: We have arrived in front of the most beautiful fountain. Do you want to take some photos?

choices.text: Sì, assolutamente! Posso scattare una foto?
choices.english: Yes, absolutely! Can I take a photo?
choices.feedback: Perfect. Asking permission or expressing intent is good.

choices.text: No, le foto sono del tutto inutili per me.
choices.english: No, photos are completely useless for me.
choices.feedback: Most tourists like photos! Try to be more positive.

choices.text: Posso nuotare nell'acqua della fontana ora?
choices.english: Can I swim in the water of the fountain now?
choices.feedback: No! It's illegal and disrespectful.

messages.text: Certo! È il posto perfetto per un ricordo. Volete una foto di gruppo?
messages.english: Of course! It's the perfect place for a memory. Do you want a group photo?

choices.text: Sì, sarebbe fantastico. Possiamo farla insieme?
choices.english: Yes, it would be fantastic. Can we take it together?
choices.feedback: Great idea. Group photos are common on tours.

choices.text: No, non mi piacciono gli altri turisti qui.
choices.english: No, I don't like the other tourists here.
choices.feedback: A bit rude! You are part of the group.

choices.text: Dov'è la farmacia più vicina a questa piazza?
choices.english: Where is the nearest pharmacy to this square?
choices.feedback: Not the time for that, focus on the photo.

messages.text: Venite tutti qui davanti all'acqua. Sorridete! Uno, due, tre...
messages.english: Everyone come here in front of the water. Smile! One, two, three...

choices.text: Che bella foto! Può fare una foto solo a me?
choices.english: What a beautiful photo! Can you take a photo of just me?
choices.feedback: Good. Asking the guide for a personal photo is very common.

choices.text: La luce è pessima per scattare foto oggi.
choices.english: The light is terrible for taking photos today.
choices.feedback: Don't be a critic, just enjoy the moment.

choices.text: Ho perso il mio ombrello nel vicolo stretto.
choices.english: I lost my umbrella in the narrow alley.
choices.feedback: The guide is taking a photo right now.

messages.text: Certamente. Mi dia il suo telefono. Ecco fatto, è venuta benissimo!
messages.english: Certainly. Give me your phone. There we go, it came out great!

choices.text: Grazie mille, Marco! È un ricordo bellissimo.
choices.english: Thank you very much, Marco! It is a beautiful memory.
choices.feedback: Expressing gratitude is always good.

choices.text: La foto è mossa, la cancelli subito, Marco.
choices.english: The photo is blurry, delete it immediately, Marco.
choices.feedback: Very rude! The guide is trying to help.

choices.text: Il biglietto per il bus, per favore, ora.
choices.english: The ticket for the bus, please, now.
choices.feedback: Wrong situation!

messages.text: Volete fare una foto anche all'interno del cortile del palazzo?
messages.english: Do you want to take a photo also inside the palace courtyard?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Possiamo entrare nel cortile ora?
choices.english: Yes, thank you. Can we enter the courtyard now?
choices.feedback: Good follow-up. Entering the courtyard is a logical next step.

choices.text: No, il cortile è troppo buio per me oggi.
choices.english: No, the courtyard is too dark for me today.
choices.feedback: Give it a try! It might be very beautiful.

choices.text: Quanto costa un chilo di pane fresco qui?
choices.english: How much does a kilo of fresh bread cost here?
choices.feedback: You are not at the bakery.

messages.text: Sì, entriamo. Guardate che bella questa colonna antica!
messages.english: Yes, let's go in. Look how beautiful this ancient column is!

choices.text: È incredibile. Di che materiale è fatta?
choices.english: It's incredible. What material is it made of?
choices.feedback: Asking about materials shows interest in the architecture.

choices.text: Voglio comprare una maglietta nuova ora.
choices.english: I want to buy a new t-shirt now.
choices.feedback: Not the time for shopping.

choices.text: Il mio cane è a casa da solo stasera.
choices.english: My dog is at home alone tonight.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the tour.

messages.text: È marmo bianco di Carrara. Veniva trasportato via fiume.
messages.english: It is white Carrara marble. It was transported by river.

choices.text: Molto interessante. Era un lavoro difficile?
choices.english: Very interesting. Was it a difficult job?
choices.feedback: Thinking about the historical process is great.

choices.text: Il marmo è troppo freddo al tatto ora.
choices.english: Marble is too cold to the touch now.
choices.feedback: Not a very helpful comment.

choices.text: Cerco la stazione dei treni più vicina.
choices.english: I am looking for the nearest train station.
choices.feedback: Stay with the tour group.

messages.text: Moltissimo! Ora usciamo e torniamo verso la piazza.
messages.english: Very much! Now we go out and return towards the square.

choices.text: Va bene. Il tour sta per finire ora?
choices.english: Alright. Is the tour about to end now?
choices.feedback: Asking about the tour's progress is natural.

choices.text: No, voglio restare qui nel cortile antico.
choices.english: No, I want to stay here in the ancient courtyard.
choices.feedback: You must follow the guide and the group.

choices.text: Dov'è il mio passaporto? L'ho perso!
choices.english: Where is my passport? I lost it!
choices.feedback: Hopefully in your pocket, but focus on the walk.

messages.text: Sì, mancano solo cinque minuti. Avete domande?
messages.english: Yes, only five minutes left. Do you have questions?

choices.text: C'è un buon posto qui per un caffè?
choices.english: Is there a good place here for a coffee?
choices.feedback: Asking for local recommendations is a great way to end.

choices.text: Perché il cielo è così blu oggi, Marco?
choices.english: Why is the sky so blue today, Marco?
choices.feedback: Not a historical question!

choices.text: Il mio letto in hotel è molto scomodo.
choices.english: My hotel bed is very uncomfortable.
choices.feedback: Wrong scenario!

messages.text: C'è un bar storico qui vicino. Spero vi sia piaciuto!
messages.english: There is a historical bar near here. I hope you liked it!

choices.text: Sì, moltissimo. Grazie di tutto e arrivederci!
choices.english: Yes, very much. Thanks for everything and goodbye!
choices.feedback: A perfect, polite way to end the tour and the conversation.

choices.text: Voglio un rimborso completo del mio biglietto.
choices.english: I want a full refund of my ticket.
choices.feedback: Unless something went terribly wrong, this is inappropriate.

choices.text: Dov'è la mia camera numero dieci stasera?
choices.english: Where is my room number ten tonight?
choices.feedback: Wrong scenario!

messages.text: Mi fa piacere! Se volete, potete lasciare una recensione online.
messages.english: I'm glad! If you want, you can leave a review online.

choices.text: Certamente, scriverò una recensione ottima.
choices.english: Certainly, I will write an excellent review.
choices.feedback: Guides appreciate good reviews.

choices.text: Non so come usare internet sul telefono.
choices.english: I don't know how to use the internet on the phone.
choices.feedback: No problem, but it's a bit of a weird response.

choices.text: Qual è la password del wifi del bar?
choices.english: What is the wifi password of the bar?
choices.feedback: Wait until you get to the bar!

messages.text: Grazie mille! Vi auguro una buona serata in città. Ciao!
messages.english: Thank you very much! I wish you a good evening in the city. Bye!

choices.text: Buona serata anche a lei, Marco. Ciao!
choices.english: Good evening to you too, Marco. Bye!
choices.feedback: Polite closing.

choices.text: A che ora parte l'ultimo bus per Roma?
choices.english: What time does the last bus for Rome leave?
choices.feedback: Wrong place to ask.

choices.text: Ho fame, dove sono i ristoranti buoni?
choices.english: I'm hungry, where are the good restaurants?
choices.feedback: Ask before the guide leaves!
